questions.question: What is the primary input to the logic synthesis process in a typical ASIC design flow?
options: The RTL (Register Transfer Level) description of the design in an HDL

options: To reduce dynamic power consumption during normal operation.
To improve the circuit's performance by reducing critical path delays.
